name: bug
description: The default workflow for fixing a defect: research reproduces it and finds its cause, build writes a failing regression test before the fix, and review checks that test.

settings.instructions: Reproduce the defect and identify its cause. If you cannot reproduce it or cannot find its cause, record that in your notes, with what you tried.
Before fixing the defect, write a regression test that reproduces it. Show that the test fails before the fix and passes after it, and name the test in the commit message.
Check that a regression test exists, that it covers the defect the spec describes, and that it would fail without the fix.
